data.name: Flurry of Blows
data.description: A sacred fist can make a flurry of blows attack as a full-attack action. This ability works like the monk ability of the same name, except the sacred fist's attack bonus from warpriest levels does not count as his warpriest level.

raw_tokens.value: Sacred Fist Class Feature.Warpriest Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

A sacred fist can make a flurry of blows attack as a full-attack action. This ability works like the monk ability of the same name, except the sacred fist's attack bonus from warpriest levels does not count as his warpriest level.
